description: This file appears to be a C header file defining data structures, inline functions, and function prototypes for working with bitmaps and compressed bitmap representations, specifically EWAH (Enhanced Word-Aligned Hybrid) bitmaps.

methods.name: uint32_t ewah_bit_popcount64(uint64_t x)
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a 64-bit integer without using built-in functions.

methods.name: int ewah_bit_ctz64(uint64_t x)
methods.description: Counts the trailing zeros in a 64-bit integer, using built-in compiler functions if available, otherwise using manual bit-shifting.

methods.name: ewah_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new EWAH bitmap pool.

methods.name: ewah_pool_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for an EWAH bitmap pool.

methods.name: ewah_new
methods.description: Allocates a new EWAH compressed bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_free
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_to
methods.description: Serializes the EWAH bitmap to a provided write function.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_strbuf
methods.description: Serializes the EWAH bitmap into a string buffer.

methods.name: ewah_read_mmap
methods.description: Reads and memory maps an EWAH bitmap from a buffer.

methods.name: ewah_checksum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum for the EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_each_bit
methods.description: Calls a callback function for each bit set in the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse the bitmap in uncompressed form.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next uncompressed word from the bitmap iterator.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an OR iterator over multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next word from the OR iterator.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources held by an OR iterator.

methods.name: ewah_xor
methods.description: Performs an XOR operation between two EWAH bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_add_empty_words
methods.description: Adds a number of empty words to an EWAH bitmap with a specified value.

methods.name: ewah_add_dirty_words
methods.description: Adds raw (dirty) words to an EWAH bitmap, with optional negation.

methods.name: ewah_add
methods.description: Adds a single word to an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_new
methods.description: Creates a new uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_word_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a bitmap with a specified number of words.

methods.name: bitmap_dup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_unset
methods.description: Unsets (clears) a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific bit.

methods.name: bitmap_free
methods.description: Frees the memory used by the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_equals
methods.description: Checks if two bitmaps are equal.

methods.name: bitmap_equals_ewah
methods.description: Checks if an uncompressed bitmap is equal to an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Checks if the bitmap is a subset of another bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Checks if an EWAH bitmap is a subset of a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_to_ewah
methods.description: Converts an uncompressed bitmap to an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_to_bitmap
methods.description: Converts an EWAH bitmap to an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_and_not
methods.description: Performs a AND NOT operation between two bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_or_ewah
methods.description: Performs OR operation between a bitmap and an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_or
methods.description: Performs OR operation between two bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set in a bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set in an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a bitmap is empty (no bits set).
